title: Q-AUDIT-DASHBOARD: chain the dashboard audit and provenance rows into the audit trail
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::dashboard:audit
**Status:** open

AUDIT-CHAIN-1 chains the tick worker's D1 (ultrastable-org). The dashboard's ops D1 `audit` and `provenance` tables are not chained yet: send them to the tick through the TICK service binding as kind `dashboard:audit` and `dashboard:provenance`, and let them age out of ultrastable-ops only after sealing.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::dashboard:audit
